objective: Replace the failed assumption that one reasoning invocation will naturally remain active for fourteen minutes with an evidence-driven runtime-continuity design and measurable live-retest contract.
acceptance_criteria: Document why plan validity did not produce runtime continuity.
Define separate liveness-production, liveness-detection, continuation, and utilization-measurement responsibilities.
Implement durable state needed to distinguish runtime death from completed work and scheduler delay.
Validate the control-plane changes and leave an exact live-retest continuation.
checkpointable_substeps: Analyze epoch 16 failure evidence and scheduler/runtime boundary.
Research relevant long-running-agent and job-runner continuity patterns.
Implement a runtime-continuity state/measurement contract and validation guards.
Validate and persist the next live experiment.
handoff_boundary: All planned design substeps are durably complete. Continue related live validation and wake-adapter feasibility work until actual successor handoff.
early_finish_fallback: Continue event-driven wake feasibility and runtime-substrate analysis; do not add unrelated filler.
progress_evidence: Epoch 16 had a valid ACTIVE plan and passing machine guards but durable progress still stopped at 00:33:25, so plan enforcement is necessary but insufficient for sustained utilization.
External durable-execution prior art converges on durable workflow state plus disposable workers rather than immortal worker sessions.
Added docs/RUNTIME_CONTINUITY_ARCHITECTURE.md and control/runtime-continuity.v1.json separating wake source, reasoning worker, durable continuation and supervisor/measurement.
Updated UTILIZATION schema and classified epoch 16 as RUNTIME_INVOCATION_ENDED_EARLY with 145-second invocation span and 779-second continuation gap.

Fresh official ChatGPT documentation shows ordinary paid scheduled tasks are documented up to hourly, but event-triggered Work tasks can execute up to 30/hour and support GitHub PR activity; this is a materially stronger no-API wake-source candidate.
Added state/WAKE_ADAPTERS.json with explicit feasibility gates, dedupe/fencing requirements and a non-recursive GitHub event-trigger proof as the next wake-adapter experiment.
